blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Millions of pesos in insurance and investment products attributed to Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband, Manases Carpio, exceeded the amounts reported as “other personal properties” in their statements of assets, liabilities, and net worth (SALNs) every year from 2022 to 2025. The House prosecution team pointed this out on Thursday in a news conference held shortly before the 36th day of the vice president’s impeachment trial started. According to Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong, trial spokesperson, the prosecution presented to the impeachment court records from seven companies — FWD Life Insurance, Manulife, Pru Life UK, BPI AIA, […]...
